Arc.description: Draws a curved line between two points (great-circle or bezier).

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: MUI palette token ("primary.main") or any CSS color. Default "primary.main".

props.name: curvature
props.description: Bulge factor for "bezier" arcs (0 = straight). Default 0.3.

props.name: id
props.description: Explicit source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: points
props.description: Number of points sampled along the arc. Default 64.

props.name: type
props.description: "bezier" (flight-path bulge) or "geodesic" (great-circle). Default bezier.

ChoroplethLayer.description:
Data-driven polygon fill — a choropleth. Maps a numeric feature property to a
color ramp (smooth) or bands ("step"), painting GeoJSON polygons accordingly,
and optionally drops a themed <Legend> built from the same stops.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons to color.

props.name: property
props.description: Feature property whose numeric value drives the fill color.

props.name: stops
props.description: `[value, color]` stops in ascending order; colors may be palette tokens.

props.name: legend
props.description:
Render a matching <Legend> from the same stops — pass `true` for defaults,
or a config object to set its title, corner, and number format. The legend
shares this layer's stops, so the two can never drift apart.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Outline color (palette token or CSS). Default "divider".

props.name: scale
props.description: "interpolate" (smooth ramp, default) or "step" (banded).

Cluster.description:
Clusters a set of points using MapLibre's native clustering, rendering cluster
bubbles and single points as themed MUI markers. Clicking a cluster zooms in
to expand it.

props.name: color
props.description: Cluster bubble color (palette token or CSS). Default "primary.main".

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Max zoom at which points cluster. Default 14.

props.name: pointColor
props.description: Unclustered point color. Default "secondary.main".

props.name: radius
props.description: Cluster radius in pixels. Default 50.

props.name: renderCluster
props.description: Custom cluster bubble. Receives the count and a zoom-to-expand callback.

props.name: renderPoint
props.description: Custom single-point marker.

ContextMenu.description:
A theme-aware right-click menu anchored to a map coordinate. Ships with
center-here / copy-coordinates / drop-marker actions, or pass your own
`items`. Because it's a plain MUI <Menu>, it inherits the app theme.

props.name: defaultItems
props.description:
Include the built-in items. Defaults to true when `items` is omitted and
false when custom items are supplied (set true to append the defaults).

props.name: items
props.description:
Menu entries — a static array or a builder called with the click
coordinate. When omitted, the built-in center / copy / drop items show.

props.name: onDropMarker
props.description:
Handle the built-in "Drop marker" action. When omitted, the menu drops and
renders its own draggable markers (click one to remove it).

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places for the copied / displayed coordinate. Default 5.

DrawControl.description:
A drawing palette: pick point / line / polygon, then click the map to add
vertices (double-click or Enter to finish, Backspace to undo, Esc to cancel).
Completed shapes render through <ShapeLayer> / <PointLayer> and are emitted
via onChange / onCreate as plain GeoJSON.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the drawn shapes. Default "primary.main".

props.name: modes
props.description: Which drawing tools to offer. Default point + line + polygon.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the full feature list on every add / undo / clear.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Fired once when a single shape is completed.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: showClear
props.description: Show the "clear all" button. Default true.

ExtrusionLayer.description:
Extrudes GeoJSON polygons into 3D prisms (MapLibre `fill-extrusion`) — for
buildings or any value mapped to height. Height can be constant or driven by
a feature property; color can be a palette token or a data-driven choropleth.
Pitch the camera (e.g. MapControls' tilt button) to see the relief.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons to extrude.

props.name: base
props.description: Base height in meters — the floor the extrusion rises from. Default 0.

props.name: color
props.description: Fill — a palette token / CSS color, or a choropleth spec for data-driven color.

props.name: height
props.description: Constant height in meters. Ignored when `heightProperty` is set. Default 0.

props.name: heightProperty
props.description: Feature property to drive height from (e.g. building floors × meters).

props.name: heightScale
props.description: Multiplier applied to `heightProperty` values. Default 1.

GeoJSONLayer.description:
Low-level escape hatch: declaratively add a GeoJSON source + layers, kept
alive across theme-driven style swaps. Build Route/Arc/Cluster-style features
yourself when the higher-level components don't fit.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON data rendered by the layers.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id for the GeoJSON source backing these layers.

props.name: layers
props.description: One or more layers to render. Memoize this array to avoid churn.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert the layers before this existing layer id (e.g. a label layer).

props.name: sourceOptions
props.description: Extra source options (clustering, generateId, …).

HeatmapLayer.description: Renders points as a density heatmap (MapLibre `heatmap` layer).

props.name: colorRamp
props.description: Override the density→color ramp (a MapLibre expression).

props.name: weightProperty
props.description: Feature property to weight points by (defaults to equal weight).

HexbinLayer.description:
Aggregates points into hexagonal or square cells colored by count (or a summed
weight) — a clearer read of density than a heatmap at a glance, and steadier
than clustering as you pan. Optionally extrudes each cell into a 3D column.

props.name: cell
props.description: Cell shape — "hex" (default) or "square" grid.

props.name: colorRamp
props.description:
`[value, color]` stops for the bin color ramp; colors may be palette tokens.
Omit to auto-build a ramp spanning the data's `[0, max]`.

props.name: extruded
props.description: Render bins as 3D columns (height ∝ value). Pitch the camera to see them.

props.name: heightScale
props.description: Meters of column height per unit value when extruded. Default scales max → ~1500m.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Cell outline color (flat mode). Default "background.paper".

props.name: radius
props.description: Approximate cell size in kilometers. Default 50.

props.name: weightProperty
props.description: Sum this point property instead of counting points.

Layer.description:
Registers a named, toggleable overlay with the map's layer registry and shows
or hides its children based on visibility. Pair with <LayerControl>.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id, used as the checkbox key in the control.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown in the LayerControl.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the control's swatch.

props.name: defaultVisible
props.description: Initial visibility for uncontrolled usage. Default true.

props.name: group
props.description: Optional section heading to group the layer under in the control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon shown in the control (set once at registration).

props.name: visible
props.description: Controlled visibility — when set, the parent owns the state.

LayerControl.description:
A collapsible MUI panel that lists registered overlay layers as checkboxes and
toggles their visibility. Layers come from declarative <Layer> children and/or
the `layers` config prop — both feed the same registry. Heavily customizable
via icons, slot props, and `renderItem` / `renderTrigger` render props.

props.name: collapseIcon
props.description: Icon for the collapse button. Default a close (×) icon.

props.name: colorCheckbox
props.description: Tint each checkbox with its layer `color`. Default uses the theme primary.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start with the panel expanded. Default false (just the icon button).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon for the trigger button + header. Default a layers icon.

props.name: layers
props.description: Optional config-driven layers, in addition to any declarative <Layer>s.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Fully render a row yourself (icon, badges, actions, …).

props.name: renderTrigger
props.description: Replace the collapsed trigger button entirely.

props.name: slotProps
props.description: Props forwarded to the inner MUI Paper / Checkbox.

props.name: sx
props.description: sx applied to the expanded panel (Paper).

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width in px.

Legend.description:
A themed map legend. Because it is plain MUI it inherits the app's theme
(light/dark, palette, shape) automatically. Pass the same `ChoroplethSpec`
your `ShapeLayer` uses to keep the legend in sync with the layer, or an
`items` list for a categorical legend.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format numeric stop values shown on a `spec`-driven legend.

props.name: items
props.description: Discrete swatches for a categorical legend. Takes precedence over `spec`.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to anchor the legend. Default "bottom-right".

props.name: spec
props.description:
Drive the legend from the same `ChoroplethSpec` a `ShapeLayer` fill takes,
so the legend and its layer share one source of truth. "interpolate"
(default) renders a continuous gradient ramp; "step" renders banded swatches.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading shown above the legend body.

Map.description:
The map container. Creates a MapLibre GL instance, exposes it via context to
children (markers, controls, layers…), and swaps the basemap style when the
MUI theme mode changes.

props.name: animate
props.description:
How `view` changes move the camera: `true` (default) eases with MapLibre's
default animation, `false` jumps instantly, or pass `AnimationOptions`
(duration, easing…) for a custom transition.

props.name: center
props.description: Shorthand for `initialView.center`. Initial-only, like `initialView`.

props.name: colorScheme
props.description: "auto" follows the MUI theme (default); "light"/"dark" force a basemap.

props.name: fitBounds
props.description:
Declarative fitBounds: whenever this prop changes, the camera adjusts to
fit the bounds. For one-off imperative moves, use the map ref instead.

props.name: fitBoundsOptions
props.description: Options for `fitBounds` (padding, maxZoom…).

props.name: hideAttribution
props.description: Hide MapLibre's built-in attribution control (attribute elsewhere).

props.name: infinite
props.description:
Let the map wrap/repeat horizontally and scroll forever. Default false —
the map shows a single, non-wrapping world (a barrier), instead of the
infinite east-west repetition MapLibre renders by default.

props.name: initialView
props.description: Initial camera position. Applied once at creation — use `view` to move the camera later.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Allow user pan/zoom/rotate. Default true.

props.name: mapOptions
props.description: Escape hatch for any other MapLibre map option.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click on the map. `e.lngLat` has the clicked coordinate.

props.name: onContextMenu
props.description: Right-click / long-press on the map.

props.name: onDblClick
props.description: Double-click on the map.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called once with the map instance after the "load" event.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Fires continuously while the camera moves (pan, zoom, rotate).

props.name: onMoveEnd
props.description: Fires once when a camera movement settles.

props.name: onZoomEnd
props.description: Fires once when a zoom gesture/animation settles.

props.name: provider
props.description:
Basemap source: a built-in id ("carto" | "osm"), a custom MapProvider,
a raw style URL, or a full MapLibre StyleSpecification. Defaults to "carto".

props.name: view
props.description:
Reactive camera position: whenever this prop changes, the map eases to it
(only the fields you provide are applied). Unlike `initialView`, the user
can still pan/zoom freely between changes — pair with `onMoveEnd` to track
where they went. Changes that match the current camera are ignored, so
feeding `onMoveEnd`'s view state back into `view` doesn't loop.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Shorthand for `initialView.zoom`. Initial-only, like `initialView`.

MapControls.description:
A cluster of MUI-styled map controls. Because it is plain MUI, it inherits the
app's theme automatically (light/dark, colors, shape).

props.name: pitchAmount
props.description: Pitch (degrees) the tilt toggle eases to. Default 60.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the zoom/compass/geolocate/fullscreen cluster.

props.name: showPitch
props.description: Show a 3D tilt toggle that pitches the camera (for fill-extrusion layers).

Marker.description:
A map marker that renders arbitrary MUI content via a React portal into a
MapLibre marker. With no children it shows a themed pin.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Which part of the marker sits on the coordinate. Set at creation time.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom marker content (any MUI element). Falls back to a themed pin.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Allow the user to drag the marker.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixel offset from the anchor point.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation in degrees.

MeasureControl.description:
A measuring tape: draw a line to read its length, or a polygon to read its
area. Values surface live (while drawing) and per-shape in deletable MUI
chips. Built on the same engine as <DrawControl>.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the drawn measurements.

props.name: modes
props.description: Tools to offer. Default distance (line) + area (polygon).

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: readoutPosition
props.description: Corner for the measurement readout chips. Default "top-right".

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit system for the readouts. Default "metric".

PointLayer.description:
Renders many points as a single GPU circle layer — cheaper than one DOM
Marker per point. For rich/interactive content, use Marker instead.

props.name: color
props.description: Palette token or CSS color. Default "primary.main".

Popup.description:
A theme-aware popup anchored to a coordinate. Renders MUI content via a portal
into a MapLibre popup, styled to match the current MUI surface (incl. dark).

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the X button. Default true.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Close when the map is clicked. Default true.

props.name: closeOnMove
props.description: Close when the map moves. Default false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when MapLibre closes the popup (X button, click, or move).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Default true.

Route.description: Draws a polyline (LineString) on the map from a list of coordinates.

props.name: beforeId
props.description: Insert before this existing layer id.

props.name: color
props.description: MUI palette token ("primary.main") or any CSS color. Default "primary.main".

props.name: id
props.description: Explicit source/layer id. Auto-generated when omitted.

SelectControl.description:
Drag a marquee box or freehand lasso to select <PointLayer> features. While a
tool is armed, panning is suspended so the drag draws a selection; release to
select. Selected points are highlighted and reported via onSelect.

props.name: points
props.description: The same points fed to your <PointLayer>. Selection runs against these.

props.name: defaultTool
props.description: Tool armed on mount. Default none (with a toolbar) / the first tool (without).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlight the selected points. Default true.

props.name: highlightColor
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the highlight. Default "secondary.main".

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired on every completed selection with the hit points and their indices.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner for the tool palette. Default "top-left".

props.name: selectionColor
props.description: Palette token or CSS color for the marquee / lasso. Default "primary.main".

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Show the toolbar. When false, `defaultTool` (or the first tool) stays armed.

props.name: tools
props.description: Tools to offer. Default box + lasso.

ShapeLayer.description: Renders GeoJSON polygons/lines as fill + outline layers, with optional choropleth fill.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON polygons and/or lines.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: A palette token / CSS color, or a choropleth spec for data-driven fill.

TimePlayback.description:
Animates time-stamped GeoJSON points along a playhead — great for trips and
trajectories. Renders a faint cumulative (or trailing) trail plus a bright
"head" of the most-recent points, driven by a themed MUI transport bar
(play/pause, scrubber, speed). Filtering happens on the GPU, so it stays
smooth with many points.

props.name: data
props.description: GeoJSON points, each carrying a numeric timestamp property.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Start playing on mount. Default false.

props.name: color
props.description: Head (most-recent) point color — palette token or CSS. Default "primary.main".

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full playthrough at 1×. Default 12.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format the playhead value shown on the transport bar.

props.name: loop
props.description: Loop back to the start at the end. Default true.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called whenever the playhead advances or is scrubbed.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner to anchor the transport bar. Default "bottom-left".

props.name: radius
props.description: Head point radius in px. Default 6.

props.name: showTransport
props.description: Render the transport bar. Default true.

props.name: timeProperty
props.description: Name of the numeric timestamp property. Default "time".

props.name: trail
props.description:
Visible trailing window, in the same units as the timestamps: only points
with `playhead - trail ≤ t ≤ playhead` show. Omit for a cumulative trail —
everything up to the playhead stays on screen.

props.name: trailColor
props.description: Trail point color. Defaults to `color`.

Tooltip.description:
A lightweight, non-interactive label anchored to a coordinate — a Popup with
no close button and tighter padding. Pair it with a Marker's hover state.

props.name: closeOnMove
props.description: Close when the map moves. Default false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when MapLibre closes the popup (X button, click, or move).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Default true.

exports.name: Arc
exports.description: Draws a curved line between two points (great-circle or bezier).

exports.name: binPoints
exports.description: Aggregates scattered lng/lat points into hexagonal or square cells, returning a GeoJSON polygon per non-empty cell with `{ value, count }`. Binning happens on a local equirectangular plane (km) centered on the data's mean latitude — exact enough for city/region-scale views, approximate near the poles or across very wide extents.

exports.name: BinProperties
exports.description: Aggregated value (`count`, or summed `weightProperty`) carried by each bin.

exports.name: buildColorExpression
exports.description: Builds a MapLibre paint expression from a choropleth spec.

exports.name: ChoroplethLayer
exports.description: Data-driven polygon fill — a choropleth. Maps a numeric feature property to a color ramp (smooth) or bands ("step"), painting GeoJSON polygons accordingly, and optionally drops a themed <Legend> built from the same stops.

exports.name: ChoroplethSpec
exports.description: Drives a layer's fill color from a feature property — a choropleth. `stops` are `[value, color]` pairs in ascending order; colors may be palette tokens.

exports.name: Cluster
exports.description: Clusters a set of points using MapLibre's native clustering, rendering cluster bubbles and single points as themed MUI markers. Clicking a cluster zooms in to expand it.

exports.name: ColorMode
exports.description: The effective color mode a basemap is rendered in.

exports.name: ColorScheme
exports.description: "auto" follows the MUI theme; "light"/"dark" force a basemap.

exports.name: ContextMenu
exports.description: A theme-aware right-click menu anchored to a map coordinate. Ships with center-here / copy-coordinates / drop-marker actions, or pass your own `items`. Because it's a plain MUI <Menu>, it inherits the app theme.

exports.name: DrawControl
exports.description: A drawing palette: pick point / line / polygon, then click the map to add vertices (double-click or Enter to finish, Backspace to undo, Esc to cancel). Completed shapes render through <ShapeLayer> / <PointLayer> and are emitted via onChange / onCreate as plain GeoJSON.

exports.name: ExtrusionLayer
exports.description: Extrudes GeoJSON polygons into 3D prisms (MapLibre `fill-extrusion`) — for buildings or any value mapped to height. Height can be constant or driven by a feature property; color can be a palette token or a data-driven choropleth. Pitch the camera (e.g. MapControls' tilt button) to see the relief.

exports.name: formatArea
exports.description: Formats an area in m² as a human label ("850 m²", "1.20 km²", "3.4 ac").

exports.name: formatDistance
exports.description: Formats a distance in metres as a human label ("850 m", "1.20 km", "2.4 mi").

exports.name: generateArc
exports.description: Generates the coordinate path for an arc between two points.

exports.name: GeoJSONLayer
exports.description: Low-level escape hatch: declaratively add a GeoJSON source + layers, kept alive across theme-driven style swaps. Build Route/Arc/Cluster-style features yourself when the higher-level components don't fit.

exports.name: haversineDistance
exports.description: Great-circle (haversine) distance between two lng/lat points, in metres.

exports.name: HeatmapLayer
exports.description: Renders points as a density heatmap (MapLibre `heatmap` layer).

exports.name: HexbinLayer
exports.description: Aggregates points into hexagonal or square cells colored by count (or a summed weight) — a clearer read of density than a heatmap at a glance, and steadier than clustering as you pan. Optionally extrudes each cell into a 3D column.

exports.name: isChoroplethSpec
exports.description: True if a `fillColor` value is a choropleth spec rather than a plain color.

exports.name: Layer
exports.description: Registers a named, toggleable overlay with the map's layer registry and shows or hides its children based on visibility. Pair with <LayerControl>.

exports.name: LayerConfig
exports.description: A fully-controlled layer definition for the `layers` config API.

exports.name: LayerControl
exports.description: A collapsible MUI panel that lists registered overlay layers as checkboxes and toggles their visibility. Layers come from declarative <Layer> children and/or the `layers` config prop — both feed the same registry. Heavily customizable via icons, slot props, and `renderItem` / `renderTrigger` render props.

exports.name: LayerEntry
exports.description: A registered overlay layer, as shown in the LayerControl panel.

exports.name: LayerInput
exports.description: A layer spec where `source` is optional (filled from the config id).

exports.name: LayerItemControls
exports.description: Handle passed to `renderItem` for a custom row.

exports.name: Legend
exports.description: A themed map legend. Because it is plain MUI it inherits the app's theme (light/dark, palette, shape) automatically. Pass the same `ChoroplethSpec` your `ShapeLayer` uses to keep the legend in sync with the layer, or an `items` list for a categorical legend.

exports.name: lineDistance
exports.description: Total length of a path (sum of segment great-circle distances), in metres.

exports.name: LngLatTuple
exports.description: A [longitude, latitude] pair.

exports.name: Map
exports.description: The map container. Creates a MapLibre GL instance, exposes it via context to children (markers, controls, layers…), and swaps the basemap style when the MUI theme mode changes.

exports.name: MapControls
exports.description: A cluster of MUI-styled map controls. Because it is plain MUI, it inherits the app's theme automatically (light/dark, colors, shape).

exports.name: MapProvider
exports.description: A pluggable basemap source. Implement this to add any MapLibre-compatible provider (MapTiler, Stadia, self-hosted, …) beyond the built-ins.

exports.name: MapStyleInput
exports.description: Anything accepted by the `provider` prop: a built-in id, a custom MapProvider, a raw style URL, or a full style spec.

exports.name: maptiler
exports.description: MapTiler basemaps — the natural production upgrade from the keyless built-ins. Requires a (free-tier) API key from https://cloud.maptiler.com. Because it's key'd, it's a factory rather than a bare provider const: call it with your key and pass the result to the `provider` prop.

exports.name: MapViewEventHandler
exports.description: A map-level event handler receiving the camera state after the event.

exports.name: Marker
exports.description: A map marker that renders arbitrary MUI content via a React portal into a MapLibre marker. With no children it shows a themed pin.

exports.name: MeasureControl
exports.description: A measuring tape: draw a line to read its length, or a polygon to read its area. Values surface live (while drawing) and per-shape in deletable MUI chips. Built on the same engine as <DrawControl>.

exports.name: pointInBox
exports.description: True when a point falls within the axis-aligned box defined by two corners.

exports.name: pointInPolygon
exports.description: Ray-casting point-in-polygon test in screen (pixel) space. The ring is an ordered list of vertices; it is treated as implicitly closed. Points exactly on an edge are reported inconsistently (as is standard for ray casting) — fine for lasso selection, where pixel-perfect edges don't matter.

exports.name: PointLayer
exports.description: Renders many points as a single GPU circle layer — cheaper than one DOM Marker per point. For rich/interactive content, use Marker instead.

exports.name: polygonArea
exports.description: Spherical area of a polygon ring, in square metres. The ring need not repeat its first point — it is treated as implicitly closed. Winding-order agnostic (always returns a non-negative area).

exports.name: Popup
exports.description: A theme-aware popup anchored to a coordinate. Renders MUI content via a portal into a MapLibre popup, styled to match the current MUI surface (incl. dark).

exports.name: providerKey
exports.description: A stable key for the provider, used to detect when a style swap is needed.

exports.name: providers
exports.description: Built-in providers, keyed by id.

exports.name: resolveAttribution
exports.description: The attribution string for a provider input, when one is known.

exports.name: resolvePaletteColor
exports.description: Resolves an MUI palette token ("primary.main", "error.light", …) against the theme. Anything that isn't a known token (e.g. "#ff0000", "rgb(...)") is returned unchanged, so callers can pass raw CSS colors too.

exports.name: resolveStyle
exports.description: Resolves the `provider` prop + color mode into a MapLibre style.

exports.name: Route
exports.description: Draws a polyline (LineString) on the map from a list of coordinates.

exports.name: ScreenPoint
exports.description: A pixel-space point, matching MapLibre's `map.project()` return shape.

exports.name: SelectControl
exports.description: Drag a marquee box or freehand lasso to select <PointLayer> features. While a tool is armed, panning is suspended so the drag draws a selection; release to select. Selected points are highlighted and reported via onSelect.

exports.name: ShapeLayer
exports.description: Renders GeoJSON polygons/lines as fill + outline layers, with optional choropleth fill.

exports.name: TimePlayback
exports.description: Animates time-stamped GeoJSON points along a playhead — great for trips and trajectories. Renders a faint cumulative (or trailing) trail plus a bright "head" of the most-recent points, driven by a themed MUI transport bar (play/pause, scrubber, speed). Filtering happens on the GPU, so it stays smooth with many points.

exports.name: Tooltip
exports.description: A lightweight, non-interactive label anchored to a coordinate — a Popup with no close button and tighter padding. Pair it with a Marker's hover state.

exports.name: useColorScheme
exports.description: Resolves the effective basemap color mode, following the MUI theme on "auto".

exports.name: useDraw
exports.description: Headless drawing state machine: wires map clicks / double-click / move / keyboard into a point/line/polygon draft and a list of completed features. Both <DrawControl> and <MeasureControl> are thin shells over this.

exports.name: useLayerRegistry
exports.description: Reads the layer registry. Throws if used outside <Map>.

exports.name: useLayerVisibility
exports.description: Returns whether a layer id is currently visible, falling back to `defaultVisible` until the layer has registered.

exports.name: useMap
exports.description: Returns the underlying MapLibre GL map instance, or null until it is ready. Use this to drop down to the raw MapLibre API whenever you need more control.

exports.name: useMapContext
exports.description: Reads the full map context. Throws if used outside <Map>.

exports.name: useMapLayer
exports.description: Adds a GeoJSON source + layers to the map and keeps them alive across theme-driven style swaps (MapLibre's `setStyle` wipes custom layers, so we re-add on `styledata`). Data and paint/layout updates are applied in place.
